provider.dataResidency: US-West (infrastructure on Render Oregon); confirm database region on the Neon console

authentication.note: Tenant-scoped key issued at /ppe/signup; sent as header x-api-key. Public discovery/verify endpoints require no auth.

postQuantum.note: Post-quantum (SPHINCS+) anchors are exposed via /verify-anchor/{id}. Do not assume every /verify proof carries an inline PQ signature until per-proof PQ display is provisioned.

webhooks.note: Replay with the same idempotency key returns 409 on reuse; ordering is guaranteed per tenant.

sla.currentBehavior: Free tier spins down on inactivity (~50s cold start) and runs WEB_CONCURRENCY=1; chained agent calls may queue and exceed typical 10-30s agent timeouts.
sla.guaranteedWith: Paid plan (Starter or above) with no spin-down and WEB_CONCURRENCY > 1.
sla.note: The 99.95% figure is the contractual target; it is guaranteed only on a paid instance. Do not route production agent traffic through the free instance.

environmentDetail.note: The top-level environment='production' refers to the crypto / go-live path. PIX is intentionally sandbox until compliance sign-off. If any payment key expires, the symptom appears at checkout (not in this card); see the env-var checklist provided out-of-band.

cors.note: Cross-origin agents and browser embeds require Access-Control-Allow-Origin on /api/* and on this document. Validate headers on the deployed instance and add permissive CORS for discovery/verify if missing.

discovery.note: llms.txt, sitemap.xml, /status, /trust and /api/openapi.json are intentionally NOT listed here yet; they will be added in the next card version immediately after the corresponding routes are provisioned, so this card never references a 404.
